rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING AGRICULTURE EDUCATION IN THE PHILIPPINES BY ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL SYSTEM OF AGRICULTURE EDUCATION INSTITUTIONS, PROVIDING FOR MECHANISMS OF IMPLEMENTATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Agriculture Education Reform Law of 1993" Provides for the structure and components  of the   proposed NATIONAL AGRICULTURE EDUCATION SYSTEM  (NAES) in  the national, regional  and provincial levels. Prescribes the functions and other roles  of theinstitutions involved in the System; provides for the  creation of the AGRICULTURE EDUCATION DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL (AEDEC) which shall carry out the policies  and the implementation of   the System. * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1993-05-17

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR STRICTER PENALTIES FOR HIT AND RUN DRIVERS
rows.abstract: Declares that --- "SECTION 2.  A driver of any motor vehicle who knowingly and intentionally runs over his victim after accidentally wounding   or injuring   him thereby causing  his death  shall be   deemed guilty  of murder.  If death  does not result  as a consequence thereof,  the offender shall  be held  liable for frustrated murder." * * *

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE 442, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, AS AMENDED, TO ENHANCE WORKERS' PARTICIPATION IN THE DETERMINATION OF APPRENTICESHIP PROGRAMS AND TO SAFEGUARD WORKERS' RIGHT TO GAINFUL EMPLOYMENT
rows.abstract: States  that any apprentice who  is retained after the period of apprenticeship SHALL  BE CONSIDERED A REGULAR EMPLOYEE; states, likewise, that the wage rates of apprentices shall  in  NO case be LESS THAN THE STATUTORY MINIMUM WAGE. Directs the beneficiary establishment to provide living allowance sufficient to cover  the apprentice's meals, transportation and   other incidental expenses. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB14258

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING INCOME SECURITY FOR WORKERS BY PROVIDING THEM UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS IN CASE OF INVOLUNTARY UNEMPLOYMENT CONTINGENCIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Covers worker members of the SSS and the GSIS for the past five  (5) years  or those who have contributed  a minimum  of sixty  (60) monthly contributions prior to dismissal, separation  or termination from service. Provides for these concerns: (1)unemployment benefit   and qualifications ;   (2) reporting requirement; and (3) penalty for violation. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB14618
